summary: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Batroolka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in qodista ceelka Curad-1, oo ay wado shirkadda Turkiga ee TPAO, ay gaartay lakab ay ka muuqan karaan calaamadaha saliidda. Wuxuu sheegay in bartilmaameedka ugu dambeeya la filayo in la gaaro bisha Diseembar.
title: Hay'adda Batroolka: Ceelka saliidda ee badda Curad-1 wuxuu gaaray lakab muhiim ah
